data.description: Within each group, models share a weekly limit. Quota is consumed proportionally to the cost of the tokens. Thus, limits will last longer with shorter tasks or using more cost-effective models. Your weekly limit is tied directly to your individual tier.

buckets.name: Weekly Limit Remaining
buckets.description: You have hit your weekly limit, it refreshes in 6 days, 16 hours. If on a supported paid plan, you can use AI credits in the interim or upgrade to a higher tier.
